query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(valorColetado) as total_coletado,
  SUM(valorFaturado) as total_faturado
FROM vendas 
WHERE cancelada = 0 AND MONTH(createdAt) = 3 AND YEAR(createdAt) = 2026;
